How We Safeguard Your Privacy

At WTD Realty Partners, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when interacting with our website and services.

01. How We Safeguard Your Privacy

We may collect the following types of information:

• Personal identification information (Name, email address, phone number, etc.);

• Demographic information (Age, gender, etc.);

• Usage data (IP address, browser type, operating system, etc.);

• Any other information you provide to us voluntarily.

02. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

• Provide and manage our services;

• Communicate with you, including responding to inquiries and sending updates;

• Improve our website and services;

• Process transactions and send relevant information;

• Conduct marketing and promotional activities;

• Ensure compliance with legal obligations.

03. Data Protection

We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information. Access to your data is restricted to authorized personnel only, and we use encryption and secure servers to protect against unauthorized access.

04. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience. Cookies are small data files stored on your device that help us understand your preferences and usage patterns. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings.

05. Third-Party Disclosure

We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to outside parties without your consent, except to trusted partners who assist us in operating our website and conducting our business. These partners are obligated to keep your information confidential.

06. Your Rights

You have the right to:

  1. Access, correct, or delete your personal information;
  2. Opt-out of receiving marketing communications;
  3. Restrict or object to the processing of your data;
  4. Withdraw consent at any time, where applicable.

07. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the revised policy on our website.
